subject.title: Seed design system for OpenClaw Windows Hub

question: Should `.agents/design/` become an authoritative, maintained design input for generated Windows Hub UI, or remain outside the repository until ownership and synchronization are defined?
rationale: The PR creates a new design authority consumed by Copilot, and code review cannot determine who owns its long-term parity with WinUI or whether it should document current behavior versus a future redesign.

options.title: Adopt as synchronized projection
options.body: Accept the design-system surface only after it uses semantic theme mappings, matches current native behavior, names an owner, and includes rendered proof.

options.title: Approve future-state redesign
options.body: Keep the concepts but label them as proposed future behavior and track the corresponding native UI changes separately.

options.title: Do not add this authority
options.body: Close or defer the PR if design guidance should remain in native code, existing docs, and Fluent resources rather than a parallel agent canvas.

recommendation.title: Adopt as synchronized projection
recommendation.body: Accept the design-system surface only after it uses semantic theme mappings, matches current native behavior, names an owner, and includes rendered proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this person to the current native chat contract and recent merge decisions in the same area.
